title: Soluner's better recipes
description: Better recipes that I wish was in base Minecraft. Some of these are for jokes though.
body:
# Soluner's Better Recipes
Created by Soluner

## What new recipes did I add?
- Anchient Debris crafting recipe
- Enchanted Golden Apple recipe (Yes, the one from 1.12, although I changed it a little)
- Trident recipe
- Crying obsidian recipe
- Totem recipe

More are to come and when they do it will update in the changelog

## Why would I want to play with this datapack?

You would want to play with this because of the QOL recipes that are in. No more grinding hours on end for a trident or having to go through over 8 trial chamber for a heavy core! It's all very cool and not at all bad to like QOL mods like this.

## Why are some of these recipes wierd or feeling off?

This is mostly a real datapack however my friends and I like putting random stuff and easter eggs into the datapacks I create. Try and find some I put in here! I also think that most of these recipes should go into base Minecraft so that may also be why.

## Is there any mods I should play with?

Yes, because I'm not listing all the crafting recipes in the screenshots I took, I would heavily recommend a mod like [Just Enough Items](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei), or [Roughly Enough Items](https://modrinth.com/mod/rei) for playing with this datapack
